name: Video: Story → Cast → Scene → Prompt (storyboard)
description: W-Reasoning: Story → CEO cast gate (reusable character_id) → Scene → Prompt → CEO storyboard gate. Chat: run video storyboard.

data.label: Story Agent
data.prompt:
You are Story Agent (video). Brief from input:

{{input}}

Prefer reusable cast ids from Master Data video_characters when the brief names known characters. Produce narrative beats for short-form video within the duration budget.
End with ONLY one JSON object: title, duration_sec, logline, beats[], characters_used[{name,role,character_id?}], tone, cta.
Do NOT invent final Veo prompts or scene cards — cast must be CEO-confirmed next.

data.label: CEO review cast
data.prompt: Confirm cast character_id mapping and reuse refs before Scene/Prompt.

taskConfig.title: CEO review: video cast
taskConfig.instructions: Confirm character_id → name mapping (and reuse library refs when listed). Approve to lock cast into Master Data video_characters and continue Scene→Prompt. Reject to stop.

data.label: Cast rejected
data.prompt: Cast was rejected by the CEO. Reply briefly: status=rejected_cast. Do not invent scenes or claim a storyboard was produced.

data.label: Scene Planner
Prompt Agent
CEO review storyboard
data.prompt: Review the storyboard PDF (scenes + character_id roster). Approve to persist as production plan.

taskConfig.title: CEO review: video storyboard
taskConfig.instructions: Open Artifacts for the storyboard PDF (character_id mapping + scenes + Veo/Flow prompts). Approve to mark ceo_approved, or reject with feedback.

data.label: Storyboard approved
data.prompt: Storyboard CEO-approved. Reply with status=ceo_approved and remind that character_id rows are in Master Data video_characters for reuse. Do not claim Veo clips were generated.

data.label: Storyboard rejected
data.prompt: Storyboard rejected by CEO. Reply status=rejected_storyboard. Orchestrator may re-trigger with feedback.
